proposal.summary: An information disclosure issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 16.2 prior to 16.2.5, and 16.3 prior to 16.3.1 allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab EE versions 16.2 prior to 16.2.5, and 16.3 prior to 16.3.1

AV.quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key

PR.quote: Owners can now only write the key, not read it.

C.quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key

proposal.recommended_next_step: Review and apply the latest GitLab EE updates to mitigate the issue.

evidence_quotes.quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.
Owners can now only write the key, not read it.
allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key
